newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain unions call off weekend airport strike.
newsitem.headline: Spain unions call off weekend airport strike.

text.p: Two Spanish unions have called off a weekend strike of ground staff at airports across the country after the airport authority AENA agreed to consider demands for a salary rise, union representatives said on Friday.
The Workers Commission (CCOO) and the Workers Trade Union (USO) had called strikes of ground workers at 40 civilian airports for every weekend in August except the 23-24.
"We are calling off the strike," the unions said in a statement. A USO representative added the strikes called for later this month would also be cancelled.
Union representatives said AENA had agreed to reconsider their demands which include higher salaries.
AENA manages the network of all civilian airports in Spain for both passengers and cargo. It has staff of more than 10,000 workers, of whom more than 2,000 are air traffic controllers.
